a.text: You will follow in the footsteps of those who sacrifice themselves, for they will show you that narrow way to life;
Charge forth, and devour the enemy alive!

—Extract from a speech prior to one of Londinium's battles

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: So in the end...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I gave him a peaceful death.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: A peaceful death?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: So you mean...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Yes. I killed him.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: That's all it is to you! Just those couple of words!!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Bastard! Bastard, bastard, bastard...!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You killed him?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I couldn't bear to see him suffer any longer...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I didn't want to see him return home, to become a madman persecuted by war.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You're just saying what you want!
Michael has been gripping the handle of his saber ever since we left the shop, but he hasn't drawn it once from its sheath.
Until now. His saber is held tight, and pointed at me.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You can kill me.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: But I don't owe you the slightest thing for your brother's death.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You killed him!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You killed your own comrade!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Nothing about what I've done is worthy of commendation.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I murdered my own soldier.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I did the one thing a doctor should never do.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: There is no fair justification for my actions.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: But it was a decision I had to make.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You've said enough!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I won't forgive you for this!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: But it's because of your brother that I saved you, too.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You resemble him a lot.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: All of you do.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Children whose eyes have been covered.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Driven, tempted, coerced.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Shoulder to shoulder...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Step after step...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Filled with fervor... rushing to your deaths.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Never should death have been so lauded.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Life is to be celebrated.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You have the right to choose life.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The earth will eternally embrace the weary children.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: That is why I saved you.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You know something? Every letter my brother sent back...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No matter what else, he'd always mention you.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: He said you were a great captain and leader, never berating people at each turn like the rest did...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Said you looked after him so much...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I believe my brother wouldn't lie...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I believe...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You must have your reasons for doing what you did.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Thank you for saving me.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'll live. I'll live on well.
I see Michael slowly hang his head.
I can sense the emotions, bottled in his heart all along.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: These past few days have shown me how incredible you are.

steps.name: Wasting Deserter
steps.text: Michael!

steps.name: Wasting Deserter
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: But I still can't bear it.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Won't you retaliate against this?!

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: You haven't retaliated either, have you?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: He thrust wide.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: Did he mean to?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It doesn't matter.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: Hey. You won't even be angry?

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: It's not you who should be bearing this, after all.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: You know you're a victim too. You're not the one to blame when these things happen.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: What happened back then, regardless of who was right or wrong, means nothing now no matter how deep you probe.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Suffering, casualty, hostility, blades, envy... all cut us far adrift from the earth.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: And in that moment, we are all the victims.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: I just don't know what to say to you.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'm sure Forrest hoped his brother would have a proper life to live.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: In that instant, he was reborn, and found his way back to the earth's sprawling roots.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: If we continue to persecute each other so...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Letting hate drive hate...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: We would do no service to their wishes.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: Theirs?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Theirs.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: And so—

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: This is the best account I can give him.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: And you needn't keep blaming yourself any longer.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: Mm. Congratulations.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: How nice for you.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: You've finally managed to get yourself killed.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Are you really giving up, just like that?

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: You're the doctor here.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: And more than that, a Druid priest.

steps.name: Quercus?
steps.text: Will you give up on life?

steps.name: Corinna
steps.text: I beg of you, take care of him for me.

steps.name: Corinna
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... I...
Never should death have been so lauded.
Life is to be celebrated.

steps.name: Derlyn
steps.text: Mum...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Take the child out of here for now.
Almost every day brings new faces before me, but I still try to remember all their names. Life should not be abandoned like this without a trace.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Quercus! What the—?!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: What's all the blood on you about?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I'll fetch you a doctor right now.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I am a doctor.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: And I was once a Victorian soldier.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Now I'm a Rhodes Island Branch Operator, and Rhodes Island Gododdin intelligence officer.
They who suffer are hung up high.
Look! That's our hero!
So the busybodies below the scaffold loudly cheer.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The Doctor's headed for Londinium.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: They need our backing on the intelligence front.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: But you...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I just took a quick trip to the refugee camp earlier.
Hero!
Hero!
The children chant in voices raised high.
But they notice not the looks of worry in their parents' eyes.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'm lucky Grani isn't back yet. I know she wouldn't let it rest without learning every last detail.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I hope everything's going smoothly on her end. Please let nothing trouble her.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: For now, I'd best pretend I'm asleep before it's too late...
Another day's dusk.
But the night won't be long.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Quercus!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Did you get some proper rest?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Quercus.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I'm here to see you.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Good evening...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Quercus!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Look at you! You didn't listen to me, did you?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Grani, the twenty-four hours are almost up.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Then I'll ground you for another twenty-four!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You lie down for me, right now!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Quercus, you look in terrible shape.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'm fine. I'll be good.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: In fact, I've baked you some biscuits.

Death casts away the dead, and salivates for the living. The most fearful torment would not so easily indulge these friends who mind each other so, nor those relatives for whom relief comes with great difficulty.
May the earth forgive.
May life endure.
May...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Quercus!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Heheh.
